name: Wixx
review:
An early 5x3 gem game built around crystal boosters. Four red crystals give a respin where the reds turn into stacked wilds, yellow crystals give a respin with crystal pays multiplied by x5, and sapphires have their own booster.

No complicated bonus to wait for – the boosters are the game. Medium volatility, a 96.61% RTP and a 2,796x cap. A tidy, classic gem game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
